title: DXF ACIS carrier, history, and consumer-geometry evidence boundaries
mode: Primary-source format-reference review plus current open-source consumer documentation; plan-only refinement

sources.revision: AutoCAD DXF reference page reviewed 2026-10-20; page is versioned 2020 documentation
sources.observed: The 3DSOLID record has AcDbModelerGeometry, group 70 modeler format version (currently 1), proprietary data in group 1 and optional continuation lines in group 3, then AcDb3dSolid and group 350 soft-owner handle to a history object.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Authoritative for the documented DXF entity group layout, not a complete ACIS/SAT/SAB semantic specification and not evidence of libdxfrw behavior.

sources.revision: Stable documentation reviewed 2026-10-20; mutable stable route, no immutable documentation build pinned
sources.observed: Docs state SAT is used for DXF R2000-R2010 and SAB for R2013+, describe reading SAT/SAB but only SAT writing, show that mesh extraction loses faces without straight boundaries, and list ACIS entities as unsupported by the bbox implementation.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Capability and limitation statements for ezdxf documentation only. Not format authority, not an executed peer result, and not evidence that every SAT/SAB route or entity family round-trips.

sources.revision: Issue reviewed 2026-10-20; current mutable issue state is open/confirmed
sources.observed: The report says the C++ importer applies the active Draft Scale Multiplier to DXF text and gives a reproduction with multiplier 10; it names FreeCAD 1.1.1 and a 1.2.0 development build.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A confirmed consumer-specific reported behavior, not a libdxfrw parser/writer defect or DXF normative rule. It motivates recording effective settings and resulting object properties in the native consumer lane.

sources.observed: Existing PAR-07/S8 gates already separate carrier preservation, reference closure, independent semantic checks, and named-consumer acceptance. This pass specifies the per-run fields and guardrails without creating new findings or top-level subplans.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Plan design only; no source implementation or consumer execution was changed.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: record DXF entity/carrier version, group-1/group-3 payload, ACDSDATA/SAB presence, and per-record disposition separately
PAR-07/S8 ownership: capture group-350 history handle and target closure separately from payload equality
PAR-07/S8 semantics: require independent expected geometry and kernel validity; lossy mesh projection is diagnostic only
FreeCAD native consumer gate: pin route/options and inspect imported properties; keep text-scale calibration distinct from ACIS semantics
assessment.planImpact: Qualification evidence now distinguishes entity/carrier bytes, history-edge closure, semantic/kernel validity, and named-consumer acceptance. ezdxf mesh conversion and bounding boxes cannot substitute for exact curved B-rep checks. FreeCAD option/text calibration remains a separate composed consumer control. No support claim is justified by these documentation/issue observations.

method.kind: Read-only web research against Autodesk format reference and open-source project documentation/issues; local plan and receipt update
method.limitations: The Autodesk page documents the 3DSOLID group layout but not arbitrary ACIS semantics. ezdxf stable documentation and FreeCAD issue state are mutable and were not executed here. SAT/SAB version claims remain capability hints pending pinned, version-authentic route evidence. No native application, kernel, external drawing, or peer binary was run.
